notes.title: Update v0.1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]
[h2]Weapons[/h2]
Improved Recoil Feedback: All weapons have been updated with enhanced recoil feedback, delivering a sharper and more responsive shooting experience for a more immersive feel. Get ready to enjoy that extra bit of “crispiness” in every shot!
[h2]Level 1[/h2]
Experimental Volumetric Fog: Added experimental volumetric fog for increased depth and atmosphere, enhancing visual immersion.
Environment Enhancements: Various environmental updates to improve overall aesthetics and atmosphere.
[h2]Tutorial Level[/h2]
Minor Bug Fixes: Addressed a range of small bugs to ensure a smoother experience for new players learning the ropes.
Models
Minor Model Updates: Small visual tweaks and improvements to models throughout the game, refining the overall look and feel.
[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
Vive Wand Enhancements: Improved support for Vive Wand users, including added functionality for the trackpad. Enjoy smoother navigation and an overall better experience tailored specifically for Vive Wand controls.

If you experience issues, please join our official [url=https://discord.gg/eQZ8wsQCPM]Discord[/url]  
Thanks,
Vino Games Team
